evals.name: route-sql-injection
evals.prompt: ช่วย review src/__review_fixtures__/deals-search/route.ts หน่อยครับ กำลังจะย้ายไปเป็น app/api/deals/search/route.ts
evals.expected_output: Lint gate run (ESLint any error); manual findings: SQL injection via q, ORDER BY injection via sort, NaN minDiscount, no try/catch / 500 shape, division by zero when stock_total=0, missing DB doc sync/tests. Verdict Blocked. No file edits.
assertions: Ran ESLint on the target file
Ran tsc --noEmit type check
Flags SQL injection via the q parameter in LIKE
Flags ORDER BY injection via sort and suggests an allow-list
Flags minDiscount parseInt NaN / missing validation
Flags missing try/catch or project error shape { error, message, statusCode }
Flags division by zero when stock_total is 0
Verdict is Blocked / not ready
No project files modified
Report written in Thai

No project files modified
